parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe made of plastic, representing the Earth with printed geographical details.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface showing continents, oceans, and countries. It can rotate around its axis for educational and reference purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around the supporting axis attached to the base.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the globe, typically made of metal, providing structural support and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the rotating sphere and maintains the globe’s upright position on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
